items.title: IndiGo, Air India to Shift Some Flights to New Mumbai Airport
items.teaser: IndiGo and Air India will move some of its international operations to Navi Mumbai International Airport as two of India’s biggest airlines expand their presence at the new aviation facility serving the country’s financial capital.

items.title: Brookfield to Open Doha Office to Deepen Middle East Reach
items.teaser: Brookfield Asset Management Ltd. is opening an office in Qatar, deepening its presence in the Middle East where many countries are grappling with the economic fallout from the war.

items.title: Goldman Cuts Kospi 12-Month Target by 25% as AI Trade Unravels
items.teaser: Goldman Sachs Group Inc. strategists slashed their target for South Korea’s Kospi Index by 25%, after raising it repeatedly this year, as concerns over the artificial intelligence trade intensify.

items.title: Singapore’s Wong Vows More Support for Workers, Energy Security
items.teaser: Singapore Prime Minister Lawrence Wong pledged more support for workers and households, and said the government would step up efforts to secure energy supplies and attract investment as the city-state confronts growing global uncertainty.

items.title: Singapore Expands Haze Inquiries to 10 Locally Based Firms
items.teaser: Singapore expanded its investigation into haze-creating fires in Indonesia that have blanketed the city-state in smog, requesting information from 10 locally registered companies.
